_readme: Advisories CI tolerates in production dependencies. Each needs an owner, a reason and a review date; CI fails once the date passes.

exceptions.reason: Next bundles its own postcss and only runs it at build time on our own CSS; attacker-controlled CSS never reaches it. The fix needs Next 16 (a major upgrade). Revisit with the Next 16 upgrade.
Flagged only because of the bundled postcss above.
